To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) the volatility structure of fuel margins is characterized by a mean-reverting process, with a regime switch that depends on the level of the margin; (ii) the drift structure of the margin is characterized by a regime switch that also depends on the level, but the switch depends on the level and on the level of volatility; and (iii) the volatility of the margin increases competition, and the cartelization effect is even stronger in periods of high volatility.
the volatility of the margins in the French retail fuel market is mean reverting.
